$comment: National web domains of each union family in the public-record union catalog (spec 2026-09-24 union catalog design, F6 and 3.1). An organization email is kept only when its registrable domain equals the organization's own web domain or one of its family's national domains here; a family-national mailbox is labelled basis family_national_site. Keys are the ledger 'aff' codes. Seeded 2026-09-24 from the national-tier records' own websites in the research snapshot.
